01 — About

From research to real-world care.

I am a Research Assistant at The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen. My work spans virtual standardized patients, clinical language models, and multimodal agents. I am interested in building and evaluating systems that connect useful research with practical deployment.

02 / CLINICAL AI
Clinical LLM · Deployment

Regional Clinical Triage LLM

Built clinical data pipelines and multi-agent patient simulations, then designed dynamic data mixing and supervised fine-tuning strategies for a regional outpatient triage model deployed in Shenzhen.
